name: Elyu Cube Clash III 2026

venue.name: SM City La Union
venue.address: J8GF+6G San Fernando City, La Union

information:
This is the sixth WCA-santioned Speedcubing Competition here in La Union.

**FOR RETURNERS:**
Base registration fee is **350php**, good for 3 events. Additional events registered shall entail 50php additional registration fee each.

**FOR FIRST TIMERS:**
Base registration fee is **250php**, good for 1 event. Additional events registered shall entail 50php additional registration fee each.
